7.10.4.1 SPNs in ExpandedFreezeFrame
[SWS_Dem_00904]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04111
⌈Each call to Dem_J1939DcmGetNextSPNInFreezeFrame shall step to the next
SPN of the ExpandedFreezeFrame for this DemEventMemory. In case no more SPN
of the ExpandedFreezeFrame definition is available, the function return value shall be
DEM_NO_SUCH_ELEMENT. The out parameter needs not to be valid in this case.⌋
[SWS_Dem_00905]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04111
⌈In case the search of [SWS_Dem_00904] needs to be interrupted due to in-
ternal implementations or limitations, the return value can be set to DEM_PEND-
ING. The out parameter needs not to be valid in this case.
The next call of
Dem_J1939DcmGetNextSPNInFreezeFrame should continue after the interrupted ele-
ment.⌋
[SWS_Dem_00906]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04057, RS_Diag_04111
⌈The function Dem_J1939DcmGetNextSPNInFreezeFrame shall trigger the Det error
DEM_E_WRONG_CONDITION in case of not supported FreezeFrameKind. Valid value is
Dem_SPNsInExpandedFreezeFrame.⌋
[SWS_Dem_00907]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04111
⌈If Dem_J1939DcmGetNextSPNInFreezeFrame is called and a further SPN of the
ExpandedFreezeFrame is found, the Dem shall copy the SPN number into SPNSup-
ported and corresponding data length of the SPN into SPNDataLength and return
E_OK.⌋
